笔.sentence: 我的笔坏了，能借给我一支笔吗？
笔.pinyin: Wǒ de bǐ huài le, néng jiè gěi wǒ yì zhī bǐ ma?
笔.english: My pen is broken; can you lend me a pen?

唱.sentence: 我喜欢听他唱歌，因为他唱得特别好听。
唱.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan tīng tā chànggē, yīnwèi tā chàng de tèbié hǎotīng.
唱.english: I like listening to him sing, because he sings especially well.

一方面.sentence: 一方面我想出国，另一方面又舍不得家人。
一方面.pinyin: Yì fāngmiàn wǒ xiǎng chūguó, lìng yì fāngmiàn yòu shěbude jiārén.
一方面.english: On the one hand I want to go abroad; on the other I cannot bear to leave my family.

验证.sentence: 这个结果还需要进一步验证。
验证.pinyin: Zhège jiéguǒ hái xūyào jìnyíbù yànzhèng.
验证.english: This result still needs further verification.

图书.pinyin: Tā juān le sānqiān cè túshū.

登机.sentence: 我们还有二十分钟就要登机了。
登机.pinyin: Wǒmen hái yǒu èrshí fēnzhōng jiù yào dēngjī le.
登机.english: We board the plane in another twenty minutes.

遥控.sentence: 这台机器可以远距离遥控。
遥控.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì kěyǐ yuǎn jùlí yáokòng.
遥控.english: This machine can be controlled remotely from a distance.

医学.sentence: 他在大学里学的是医学。
医学.pinyin: Tā zài dàxué lǐ xué de shì yīxué.
医学.english: What he studied at university was medicine.

苍蝇.sentence: 夏天厨房里常常有苍蝇。
苍蝇.pinyin: Xiàtiān chúfáng lǐ chángcháng yǒu cāngying.
苍蝇.english: In summer there are often flies in the kitchen.

偷.pinyin: Yǒu rén tōu le wǒ de zìxíngchē.

河.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé de shuǐ hěn qīng.
河.english: The water in this river is very clear.

中.pinyin: Bēizi zhōng hái yǒu yìdiǎn shuǐ.
中.english: There is still a little water in the cup.
